series_layout: each list holds one value per month from the first month on; null where the clear share is below the minimum or there is no product

applicability.rule: The snow recipe is recorded as not applicable if, in every elevation band of the fixed band set, fewer than 1 per cent of the clear catchment-pixel-days in the sample have NDSI snow cover of 40 or more. Otherwise the full recipe is run. The decision, its reason and the sample's limits are stored with the result.
applicability.sampleRule: December to February of the winters 2005/06, 2010/11, 2015/16 and 2020/21: four winters five years apart across the record
applicability.reason: In every elevation band of the fixed_500m set fewer than 1 per cent of the clear catchment-pixel-days in the sample have NDSI snow cover of 40 or more
applicability.sample_note: Written 2026-10-30 before any MOD10A1 value of this catchment was read. The first place's snow recipe needs 9,300 daily products for 2001 to 2025; the catchment's highest height is 1,330 m in a Mediterranean climate, so the lane checks a sample of winter months before deciding whether the full recipe applies.

archive_gaps: 10 days absent from Planetary Computer (A2016049, A2016050, A2016051, A2016052, A2016053, A2016054, A2016055, A2016056, A2016057, A2016058); not checked against NASA CMR.
limitations: MOD10A1 sees snow only on clear days. Cloudy days are left out, not filled.

The check covers 12 sample months (December to February of four winters five years apart) and says nothing about other months or winters; snow that fell and melted in an unsampled week would not be seen.
Each 500 m pixel is called snow-covered or not as a whole; patchy or thin snow can be missed.
Terra's overpass has drifted earlier since 2020 (NASA), so later years are seen with a lower sun.
The validation studies of this product that the registry cites were made in the Moroccan Atlas; they are not evidence for this catchment, and no validation for this catchment was done.
Not applicable means the recipe is not run here because the sample shows almost no snow. It is not a finding that snow never falls in the catchment.
